title: [Feature][Quantization] Backport ModelSlim W4A8 dynamic Linear support to v0.32.0rc
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?

Backport the ModelSlim W4A8 dynamic Linear support from [#20469](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/20469) to the `releases/v0.32.0rc` branch. This enables ModelSlim `W4A8_DYNAMIC` Linear layers with symmetric per-channel INT4 weights and dynamic per-token INT8 activations, including packed checkpoint loading, TP scale-bias reduction, and the A8W4 grouped-matmul path. Small TP output partitions retain ND layout when they do not meet INT4 NZ alignment; fused-MoE weights retain explicit NZ conversion.

The backport is based directly on the official `releases/v0.32.0rc` branch. Qwen3.8 Flash-Next support from #16981 is already present in this release branch and is not duplicated here.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes. Users can load ModelSlim `W4A8_DYNAMIC` Linear weights with symmetric per-channel INT4 weights and per-token INT8 activations. Per-group INT and non-ModelSlim checkpoints are rejected by this Linear scheme. Existing MXFP schemes are outside this change.

Release note: `release_notes/fragments/20507.yaml`.

### How was this patch tested?

- The W4A8 CPU unit-test changes from #20469 are included, covering packed weight shape, TP partition constraints, NZ alignment, scale bit encoding and bias reduction, asymmetric-offset rejection, empty input, and prepared-input protection.
- The patch was assembled by applying the two W4A8 implementation commits and the test commit from #20469 onto `releases/v0.32.0rc` without conflicts.
- NPU service startup, accuracy, and performance validation on the 0.32.0rc environment remain pending.

### Checklist

- [x] Boundary / edge-case coverage
- [x] Regression test
- [x] Error / failure path coverage
- [x] Meaningful & reliable tests
- [ ] Performance impact: hardware benchmarks remain pending.
